report:
Final settings: batch_size 4, workers 14, prefetch 0. Final throughput: 700.0 req/s at p99 199.0 ms, within the 200 ms hard limit.

Start: batch_size 8, workers 1, prefetch 0 gave 100.0 req/s at p99 197.2 ms.
Method: an exhaustive search of the bench.py model over batch_size 1 to 9, workers 1 to 29, prefetch 0 to 39. Only settings with p99 at or below 200 ms were kept. The limit was treated as a hard limit (SPEC.md), never traded for throughput.
Best five within the limit:
- batch 4, workers 14, prefetch 0: 700.0 req/s, p99 199.0 ms (chosen)
- batch 5, workers 11, prefetch 0: 687.5 req/s, p99 200.0 ms (exactly at the limit, no margin)
- batch 4, workers 13, prefetch 1: 676.0 req/s, p99 197.3 ms
- batch 4, workers 12, prefetch 3: 672.0 req/s, p99 199.7 ms
- batch 5, workers 10, prefetch 1: 650.0 req/s, p99 198.3 ms
Note: the chosen setting leaves only 1.0 ms of p99 margin in this model. If real traffic varies, 676.0 req/s (batch 4, workers 13, prefetch 1, p99 197.3 ms) gives 2.7 ms margin.
